department: Max Planck School Matter to Life (integrated MSc/PhD)

deadline.value: Dec 1, 2026 for the 2027 intake (applications open Sep 1)
deadline.quote: From 1 September to 1 December 2026, you can apply for the Integrated MSc/PhD Program 2027.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the pages checked

supervisor.value: You find a supervisor among the school's faculty during the master's phase
supervisor.quote: you need to find a supervisor within the Matter to Life faculty and obtain a GPA of at least 2.0 in the Master

funding.value: Full funding for up to five years: €1,565 stipend in the master's phase, then a TVöD/TV-L E13 contract
funding.quote: The Max Planck School Matter to Life offers full funding for up to five years.

entry_route.value: Entry is only at the master's phase; master's holders may apply but also start there
entry_route.quote: Please note: You can only enter our program at the Master's phase and not directly at the PhD phase! | Applicants who already have a Master's degree are eligible to apply as well.

app_fee.quote: There is no fee to submit your application!

fee_waiver.quote: There is no fee to submit your application!

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 90 or IELTS 6.5; the score can come as late as July 15 of the start year
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL internetbased (IBT) - minimum 90 out of 120 points

also.quote: Please submit the results of a valid English test no later than July 15th of the year in which your program begins

english_waiver.value: Not needed if your previous degree was taught in English (within the three years before you start)
english_waiver.quote: Proof of English language proficiency is required for non-native English speakers unless your previous program was taught in English.

notes: Interdisciplinary (physics, chemistry and biology); joint degree from Heidelberg and Göttingen. Applicants with Indian certificates must also submit APS verification, per the school's FAQ.
